text: Licence plates in Belgium use** red text**. You can recognise this distinct colour even through the blur.
text_zh: 比利時的車牌使用**紅字**。即使透過模糊處理，你也能辨認出這種獨特的顏色。

text: Belgium uses **white** bollards with a **yellow rectangular reflector **on the front and [white ](https://goo.gl/maps/dsvrRBcicD5XmBN59)on the back. A second type of bollard is [dark brown](https://goo.gl/maps/Wefn7bM6gmvjQ7DY7) with two red stripes at the top. Occasionally, other bollards can be seen.
NOTE: Denmark uses similar white bollards, but they have a red stripe at the top and the reflector is not rectangular. The dark brown bollard with two red stripes can also be seen in the Netherlands.
text_zh: 比利時使用**白色**路樁，正面帶有**黃色矩形反射片**，背面為[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/dsvrRBcicD5XmBN59)。第二種路樁是[深棕色](https://goo.gl/maps/Wefn7bM6gmvjQ7DY7)，頂部有兩條紅線。偶爾也能看到其他路樁。
備註：丹麥使用類似的白路樁，但頂部有一條紅線且反射片不是矩形的。頂部有兩條紅線的深棕色路樁也可以在荷蘭看到。

text: Belgium uses A-type guardrails with **yellow **reflectors.

NOTE: In Europe, only Spain, Andorra, and Belgium use these reflectors. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/60f6054f4e76b03092956de8/930bd2e7-57fa-4807-8e8a-733ba5a702a8/europeguardrail.png?format=2500w).
text_zh: 比利時使用帶有**黃色**反射片的 A 型護欄。
備註：在歐洲，只有西班牙、安道爾和比利時使用這些反射片。關於歐洲護欄的良好概覽，請參見[這張圖表](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/60f6054f4e76b03092956de8/930bd2e7-57fa-4807-8e8a-733ba5a702a8/europeguardrail.png?format=2500w)。

text: Most poles in Belgium are concrete, square shaped, and have tiny holes running up them. They often have** small metal wrappings** around them. The second most common type of pole has [**oval-shaped holes**](https://goo.gl/maps/XVRAYg1wmhNJQxg17). You can find many different types of concrete poles in Belgium.
NOTE: The small metal wrappings can be found in France as well.
text_zh: 比利時的大多數電線桿都是混凝土材質的方形桿，沿著桿身貫穿著小孔。它們周圍常常纏繞著**金屬包紮帶**。第二常見的電線桿類型有[**橢圓形孔**](https://goo.gl/maps/XVRAYg1wmhNJQxg17)。您可以在比利時找到許多不同類型的混凝土電線桿。
備註：金屬包紮帶在法國也能看到。

text: Directional signs in Belgium are most often blue or [white](https://goo.gl/maps/xWnWdzWmbcPDPTE4A).
text_zh: 比利時的方向路牌最常是藍色或[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/xWnWdzWmbcPDPTE4A)。

text: Road signs often have an additional **small blue sign**. In other European countries, these small signs are usually just white.
text_zh: 道路標誌通常帶有一個額外的**藍色小標誌**。在其他歐洲國家，這些小標誌通常只是白色的。

text: Belgium uses pedestrian crossing signs without any stripes, but with **two horizontal dotted lines**. The man on the sign has a **square head**.
NOTE: France and the Netherlands use a pedestrian sign with a regular zebra crossing with five vertical stripes.
text_zh: 比利時使用的行人穿越道標誌沒有斑馬線圖案，而是帶有**兩條水平虛線**。標誌上的人有一個**方頭**。
備註：法國和荷蘭使用帶有普通斑馬線（五條垂直條紋）的行人標誌。

text: Kilometre markers in Belgium are often green, but can have [red text](https://goo.gl/maps/s18C6tj6L1qZXbVZ6) as well.
text_zh: 比利時的公里標誌通常是綠色的，但也可以帶有[紅色文字](https://goo.gl/maps/s18C6tj6L1qZXbVZ6)。

text: Belgium uses white chevrons, with a red arrow.
NOTE: The Netherlands also uses this chevron. You will not see these in France.
text_zh: 比利時使用帶有紅色箭頭的白色轉彎標誌。
備註：荷蘭也使用這種轉彎標誌。你在法國不會看到這些。

text: A lot of rural roads in Belgium are made out of **concrete slabs**, almost like you would see in the Philippines or Thailand.
NOTE: The Netherlands almost never uses concrete slabs for roads.
text_zh: 比利時的許多鄉村道路都是由**水泥板**鋪成的，幾乎就像你在菲律賓或泰國看到的一樣。
備註：荷蘭幾乎從不使用水泥板來鋪路。

text: Belgium uses all **white **road lines. These can be continuous or broken. Roads are often accompanied by** bike lanes** on both sides.
NOTE: Bikes and cycling lanes are most common in the Netherlands, but they can be often seen in Belgium as well.
text_zh: 比利時全部使用**白色**道路標線。這些標線可以是實線或虛線。道路兩側通常伴有**自行車道**。
備註：自行車和自行車道在荷蘭最常見，但在比利時也很常見。

text: A lot of houses in Belgium are made of distinctive **red bricks**.
NOTE: This is more common in the North and West of the country.
text_zh: 比利時的許多房屋都是由獨特的**紅磚**造成的。
備註：這在該國北部和西部更常見。

text: Houses in the South of the country use a lot of stone, have gray tones and generally look more French.
text_zh: 該國南部的房屋大量使用石頭，呈灰色調，整體看起來更有法國風格。

text: Signposts in Belgium are often **orange**. The backs of signs are also sometimes orange. This is unique to Belgium.
text_zh: 比利時的路牌柱通常是**橘色**的。標誌背面有時也是橘色的。這是比利時獨有的。

text: Street name signs in Belgium are very diverse, and often unique to a city. Most common colours are **white **and **dark** **blue**. They often have the** town or city name** written on them.
NOTE: These signs often have variable designs, but most of them are fairly short and tall. In comparison, Dutch street signs are almost always much longer than they are tall.
text_zh: 比利時的街名牌非常多樣化，且通常為某個城市所獨有。最常見的顏色是**白色**和**深** **藍色**。它們上面通常寫有**城鎮或城市名稱**。
備註：這些標誌的設計往往不盡相同，但大多數都相當短而高。相比之下，荷蘭的路牌幾乎總是寬度遠大於高度。

text: **Town entry signs** in Belgium are white with a black border. They also mention the name of the city or municipality in bold, black text.
text_zh: 比利時的**城鎮入口標誌**為白底黑邊。它們還會以黑色粗體字註明城市或市鎮的名稱。

text: Priority signs in Belgium have an **orange **diamond and are much **smaller **than in other countries.
text_zh: 比利時的幹線優先標誌有一個**橘色**菱形，且比其他國家**小得多**。

text: Bus stops are always marked by **yellow signposts**. Bus shelters often have **yellow roofs**.
text_zh: 公車站總是標有**黃色站牌柱**。公車亭通常有**黃色屋頂**。

text: Traffic lights are most often supported by black-and-yellow or red-and-white **striped poles**.
NOTE: The regional differences are discussed in Step 2.
text_zh: 紅綠燈最常由黃黑相間或紅白相間的**條紋桿**支撐。
備註：區域差異將在步驟 2 中討論。

text: Belgium uses these **red** water hydrants signs with the letter **H **on top.
NOTE: You can also find these in Germany.
text_zh: 比利時使用這種**紅色**消防栓標誌，頂部帶有字母 **H**。
備註：你在德國也能看到這些。

text: Almost all roads (big or small) in Belgium use **gutters **on both sides. This is much less common in neighbouring countries.
text_zh: 比利時幾乎所有道路（無論大小）兩側都有**排水溝**。這在鄰國要罕見得多。

text: Belgian bicycle paths have short dashed outer lines.
text_zh: 比利時的自行車道外側為短虛線。

text: After Germany, Belgium is the next country in which you can find the most **blurred houses.**
text_zh: 繼德國之後，比利時是你能找到最多**被模糊處理的房屋**的國家。

text: Coverage with a** red car** and a **long antenna **can rarely be seen in Belgium.
NOTE: This is much more common in Ukraine.
text_zh: 帶有**紅色車輛**和**長天線**的街景覆蓋在比利時很少見。
備註：這在烏克蘭要常見得多。

text: Belgium also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of Western Europe also has smallcam.
text_zh: 比利時也有第 4 世代「小車相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，架設位置比一般的第 4 世代低，且底部有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前方帶有微小凸出。該模糊也可能是完全透明的，使其更難察覺。
註：西歐大部分地區也有小鏡頭。

text: Belgium is generally **flat **in the northwest of the country, especially near the coast. The further [south east](https://goo.gl/maps/P9sjaiMA1DEcR4VY9) you go, the **hillier**.
text_zh: 比利時的西北部整體上非常**平坦**，尤其是靠近海岸的地方。越往[東南部](https://goo.gl/maps/P9sjaiMA1DEcR4VY9)走，地勢越**多丘陵**。

text: Belgium has 3 official languages.
- **Dutch **(Flemish), spoken in **Flanders**, the Northern part of Belgium. There is an abundance of letters and combinations like z, w, ee and ij.
- **French **(Walloon), spoken in **Wallonia**, the Southern part of Belgium. You can see letters like ç, é, è and à.
- **German**, spoken in **Ostbelgien**, a small region in the east of the country. You can see letters like ä, ü, ö and ß.
text_zh: 比利時有 3 種官方語言。
- **荷蘭語**（佛萊明語），用於比利時北部的**佛萊明大區**（Flanders）。有大量的字母和組合，如 z、w、ee 和 ij。
- **法語**（瓦隆語），用於比利時南部的**瓦隆大區**（Wallonia）。你可以看到像 ç、é、è 和 à 這樣的字母。
- **德語**，使用於該國東部的小區域**東比利時**。你可以看到像是 ä、ü、ö 和 ß 等字母。

text: Brussels, the capital of Belgium, is **bilingual**. You will see both French and Dutch on signs.
text_zh: 比利時首都布魯塞爾是**雙語區**。你會在標誌上同時看到法語和荷蘭語。

text: Bus stop signs in Flanders (and Brussels) have a **white rectangle** at the top. In Wallonia they will have a [**yellow top**](https://goo.gl/maps/RXMysmC593bvR99HA).
text_zh: 法蘭德斯（以及布魯塞爾）的公車站牌頂端有一個**白色長方形**。瓦隆尼亞的公車站牌則有[**黃色頂端**](https://goo.gl/maps/RXMysmC593bvR99HA)。

text: In Flanders (and Brussels), 95% of warning signs have a **thick red outline**, without a white border. Contrarily, you will most often find warning signs with a [**small white outline**](https://goo.gl/maps/UAv4N67VDRvvcSjJ7) in Wallonia.
NOTE: The signs found in Flanders are the same as the Spanish ones.
text_zh: 在法蘭德斯（以及布魯塞爾），95% 的警告標誌都有**粗紅邊框**，且沒有外圍白邊。相反地，在瓦隆尼亞最常看到的警告標誌則帶有[**細白外框**](https://goo.gl/maps/UAv4N67VDRvvcSjJ7)。
注意：法蘭德斯看到的標誌與西班牙的標誌相同。

text: Traffic lights held up by **yellow-and-black** poles are unique to Flanders. In contrast, Wallonia and Brussels frequently use a **red-and-white** design.
text_zh: 由**黃黑相間**燈桿支撐的紅綠燈是法蘭德斯特有的。相比之下，瓦隆尼亞和布魯塞爾則經常使用**紅白相間**的設計。

text: Phone codes in Belgium are very useful to determine the region you are in. They are **9 **digits long. The 1 or 2 number(s) after the leading 0 indicate the area code.
0**X** XXX XX XX (Brussels, Antwerp, Liege, Ghent.)
0**XX** XX XX XX (Other cities.)
NOTE: Mobile numbers start with **04 **and are 10 digits long.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 比利時的電話區號對於確定你所在的區域非常有用。電話號碼長度為 **9 **碼。開頭 0 後面的 1 或 2 個數字即代表區號。
0**X** XXX XX XX（布魯塞爾、安特衛普、列日、根特。）
0**XX** XX XX XX（其他城市。）
注意：行動電話號碼以 **04 **開頭，長度為 10 碼。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: As mentioned before, **municipality names** are often mentioned on street signs, usually in smaller font than the street name. The map shows a selection of recognizable street signs in the bigger cities.
NOTE: Of the big cities, **Bruges **(Brugge) is an exception to the rule of signs usually mentioning the municipality name.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 如前所述，路牌上經常會標示**自治市名稱**，字體通常比路名小。地圖展示了較大城市中一些具辨識度的路牌選輯。
注意：在大城市中，**布魯日**（Brugge）是不適用「路牌通常會標示自治市名稱」這項規則的例外。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The Ardennes, located in the southeast part of Belgium, have a very distinct landscape. You can see a lot of **steep hills**, dense **forests, **and **valleys**.
NOTE: The Ardennes extend partially into France, Luxembourg, and Germany.
text_zh: 阿登地區位於比利時東南部，擁有非常獨特的地貌。你可以看到許多**陡峭的山丘**、密集的**森林**與**山谷**。
注意：阿登地區延伸至法國、盧森堡和德國的部分區域。

text: The coastal plain is extremely flat and consists of so-called **polders**, which are man-made fields at or below sea level, surrounded by many waterways. This landscape is situated near the North Sea coast, as well as near the western part of the border with the Netherlands, particularly around Antwerp.
NOTE: This part of Belgium is especially often confused with the Netherlands. Carefully look around for clues to distinguish the two countries if you find yourself in this landscape.
text_zh: 海岸平原極為平坦，由所謂的**圩田**（polders）組成，這是位於海平面或海平面以下、四周圍繞著眾多水道的人工田地。這種地貌位於北海海岸附近，以及與荷蘭接壤的西部邊境附近，特別是在安特衛普周邊。
注意：比利時的這個部分特別容易與荷蘭混淆。如果你發現自己處於這種地貌中，請仔細觀察四周的線索來區分這兩個國家。

text: Many parts of the Belgian **North Sea coast** are lined by apartment blocks, in a manner that is often derisively referred to as a “wall” of buildings by locals.
Near the coast, you will also sometimes be able to spot a [dune landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/oM2uuPVVeUfEZt839), with low bushes, long grass and sandy soil.
text_zh: 比利時**北海海岸**的許多地方都排滿了公寓大樓，當地人常嘲諷地稱之為建築「牆」。
在海岸附近，你時不時也能發現[沙丘景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/oM2uuPVVeUfEZt839)，帶有矮灌木、長草和沙質土壤。

text: Baarle-Hertog, located north-east of Antwerp, is composed of several exclaves and enclaves of Belgium and the Netherlands. You can often see the country's borders in this city (indicated by **small white crosses**). Street name signs tell you whether you are in Belgium or The Netherlands.
text_zh: 巴勒海托赫位於安特衛普東北方，由比利時和荷蘭的多個飛地與嵌入地組成。在這個城市裡你經常可以看到國界（由**白色小十字**標示）。街道路牌會告訴你你是在比利時還是荷蘭。
